I also got the same error but it will resolved in following 2 steps.

  1. install openjdk

  2. Write the following code

     import pyspark
 from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

 #Create SparkSession
 spark = SparkSession.builder
             .master("local[1]")
             .appName("myapp.com")
             .getOrCreate()
